propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared discovery kernel instead of combining workflow-authored criteria with unconditional fan-in and packaged overlay selection.

Effective disables, project-specific criteria applicability, and explicit dollar budgets must be enforced; missing blocking-capable coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless a real blocking finding exists.
After one criterion fails, remaining independent criteria continue execution with earlier successes retained; systemic failures and cancellation stop work with exact usage accounting.
Base-reviewer topology, Round B one-hop path, per-overlay context overrides, prompt contracts, and model-ladder resolution must remain unchanged from pre-cutover behavior.

Project DET criteria execute through detector selector outside LLM fan-in; project LLM criteria select by effective globs with zero execution and reason provenance for disabled or inapplicable criteria.

Versioned safe discovery trace persists only in internal code-review journal and never in public review response or status projection; shadow contract tests report no differences outside approved delta allowlist.
